title: Hospitals reporting heart bypass surgery
source: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, HHS and the Society of Thoracic Surgeons
definition: Hospitals with a published positive case count for Medicare’s coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) mortality measure. Points mark verified provider addresses. For multi-campus providers, the Society of Thoracic Surgeons must identify the individual hospital in a single-site bypass report. Unresolved campuses and providers with suppressed case counts are omitted. Coverage is partial and describes historical procedures.

sourceDetails.locationMatch: Matching CCN, normalized street, state and either city or five-digit ZIP. HHS must identify one physical address and point, or a reviewed STS report must isolate one campus. The HHS source-system and geocoded coordinates must agree within one mile.
